properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued November 20 at 4:37PM EST until November 20 at 6:30PM EST by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southeastern Duval County in northeastern Florida...
Northern St. Johns County in northeastern Florida...

* WHEN...Until 630 PM EST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 436 PM EST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area through this evening. This additional rain will result
in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Jacksonville, Unf, Arlington, Ponte Vedra Beach, Jacksonville
Beach, Atlantic Beach, Neptune Beach, Craig Field, San Pablo and
Fort Caroline.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 630 PM EST THIS EVENING

properties.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued November 20 at 4:06PM EST until November 21 at 5:00AM EST by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Minor saltwater flooding.

* WHERE...Middle and Upper Keys.

* WHEN...Through early Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...Minor saltwater flooding of low elevation streets and
lots is likely. Some storm drains will overflow, and some
seawalls and docks will be overtopped. Boaters can expect less
clearance under fixed bridges. Motorists should remember that
persistent puddles around the times of high tide are almost
certain to contain a mix of saltwater.
properties.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.

NWSheadline: COASTAL FLOOD STATEMENT REMAINS IN EFFECT
